summary: Integrate a true in-website embedded Facebook Messenger chat, giving visitors an experience similar to the AI chat but connected directly to Messenger.
narrative: The user requested an embedded, in-website chat experience instead of just redirecting buttons. TECHNICAL LIMITATION: Facebook explicitly blocks embedding personal profiles (m.me/username) inside iframes/websites for security (Clickjacking protections) and graph API reasons. The official Facebook embedded chat (Meta Customer Chat Plugin) STRICTLY requires a Facebook Business/Creator Page. Our execution plan is to implement the official Meta Chat Plugin inside the Next.js layout, which provides a true in-website chatting experience. We will guide the owner on taking 2 minutes to convert/create a Page (linked to their personal account) to unlock this Developer feature.
principles: Atomic Commits - High commit history volume by slicing the work.
Official Integration - Use the official Meta chat plugin for real-time syncing.
Non-blocking - Load the script asynchronously via next/script so it does not hurt Core Web Vitals.
Layout Harmony - Render the plugin on the bottom left to avoid overlapping the Floating Hub AI.
